pages.title: Server policy
pages.text: speakerRange sets the range ceiling: 1–512, default 64. disableUpload blocks uploads. allowRemoteStreams defaults off and is independent of uploads.

pages.title: Limits and cache
pages.text: maxUploadSize defaults to 5 MiB, capped at 100 MiB. The client uses a 500 MiB audio cache. Server policy overrides client defaults while connected.

pages.title: Debug logs
pages.text: debugLogging enables detailed logs. Enable it when diagnosing a problem, then disable it to reduce log volume.
